description: Context-menu latency test matrix: modules x profile x autospell x skia x start. Cells expand per preset; unspecified axes use their default (first value, start=warm).

notes.skia: default = no SAL_SKIA variable (26.8 default is raster; gerrit 208182 makes GPU opt-in); raster = SAL_SKIA=raster forced.
notes.autospell: Writes Linguistic/General/IsSpellAuto into the (copied) profile; A/B diagnostic only, never a shipped default.
notes.profile: clean = fresh profile directory; user = a COPY of an existing profile (--user-profile), the original is never touched.
notes.start: cold = fresh process per trial, first menu only; warm = one process, repeated menus.

owner-quick.description: Owner Mac run: 3 modules, baseline plus one-axis-at-a-time toggles (~12 cells).

linux-parity.description: Linux regression parity: baseline warm and cold for each module.

full.description: Full cartesian product of all axes.
